scope: same-source counterfactual branch contrast; no metric trajectory reconstruction

measurement_contract.abstention: if either branch lacks the minimum common intervals, exclude the pair without zero filling

progress.semantics: ordinal relative progress candidate; diagnostic until independent speed-swap validation passes

normalization.definition: raw left-minus-right descriptor divided by absolute same-interval branch common mode

temporal_consistency.definition: maximum fraction of nonzero interval differences sharing one sign

promotion_criteria.required_holdout: model selection and threshold calibration must precede untouched confirmatory twins

downstream_mapping.CCFC-S: ordinal consistency between delta structure and delta native action
downstream_mapping.CFAC-S: single-branch structural alignment after a frozen action-to-structure calibration
downstream_mapping.FAU: not supplied by this protocol; requires a logged-GT-compatible channel
